decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 1527(BD03)-DW-4600-101-PL REV P entitled Existing Location Plan, Drawing 1527(BD03)-DW-4600-102-PL REV P entitled Proposed Location, Drawing 1527(BD03)-DW-4600-103-PL REV P entitled Existing Plan, Drawing 1527(BD03)-DW-4600-104-PL REV P entitled Proposed Plan, Drawing 1527(BD03)- DW-4600-105-PL REV P entitled Existing Elevations, Drawing 1527(BD03)-DW-4600-106-PL REV P entitled Existing Elevations, Drawing 1527(BD03)-DW-4600-107-PL REV P entitled Proposed Elevations, Drawing 1527(BD03)-DW-4600-108-PL REV P entitled Proposed Elevations, Drawing 1527 (BD03)-DW-4600-109-PL REV P entitled Elevations and Roof Plan submitted 15 February 2012 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
